drafted_from: tool row in tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/tool-rows.json, do-work/say_a_line_in_kokoro.py, test/fixtures and tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/test/test_voice_ab.py
start_here: Say to your AI: "Say my narration line in line.json in the Kokoro voice bm_lewis, with the set pauses, into take-kokoro.wav."

lists.label: Settings
lists.holds: One row per tool and scope (a person, a film, a piece or the whole account): the settings that tool reads when it runs, as JSON.

instructions: 1. Pour the two example settings rows into your own list:settings (see pour), or write line.json alone (units, pause_after, inner_most, script) and use the defaults.

2. Say the line in start_here. Your AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: "tool:say-a-narration-line-in-a-kokoro-voice"}, installs mlx-audio, misaki, numpy and soundfile if missing (a Mac with Apple silicon) and runs the command in given. If you keep a list:settings row for this folder (record:setting:compare-voice-and-music-models~film~<film>) your AI reads it with tool:read-a-tool-setting, saves it to a file and adds --settings-record that file --film <film>; its values go over the defaults.
3. Read the last line: {"result": {take, voice, model, seconds, sample_rate}} or {"error": "what to change"}.
4. Measure it beside the other voices with tool:measure-narration-takes.

worked_examples.title: Three units said as three generations, joined by the line's pauses
worked_examples.ask: Say my narration line in Kokoro bm_lewis.
worked_examples.given: Read from tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/do-work/say_a_line_in_kokoro.py; its units, pauses and refusals are tested in tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/test/test_voice_ab.py with a stand-in model (each unit one generation with voice, speed 1.0 and lang_code b for bm_*). line.json = {"script":"Close. The kettle is on... and the toast is burning. Aren't you, Morwenna?","units":["Close.","The kettle is on... and the toast is burning.","Aren't you, [Morwenna](/mɔːwˈɛnə/)?"],"pause_after":[0.65,0.4,0.0],"inner_most":0.45,"hear_prompt":"Morwenna.","voice_reference":"reference-take.wav","vowel_check":{"word":"close"}} (from tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/test/fixtures/narration-line.json). Run: python3 -I tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/do-work/say_a_line_in_kokoro.py line.json bm_lewis take-kokoro.wav
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result":{"take":"take-kokoro.wav","voice":"bm_lewis","model":"mlx-community/Kokoro-82M-bf16","seconds":<length, at least 1.05 s because the set pauses alone are 0.65 + 0.4>,"sample_rate":24000}}: three generations (Close. / The kettle is on... and the toast is burning. / Aren't you, Morwenna? with the IPA word fixed), the silence inside unit 2 capped at 0.45 s, 0.65 s then 0.4 s between units, a 24-bit WAV. Without arguments: {"error":"pass <line.json> <voice> <out.wav>, the voice a Kokoro voice name such as bm_lewis"}.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
